name: Foreign vessel fishing licence or permit requirement
description: Section 3 sets a legal requirement concerning the use of a foreign vessel for fishing within any maritime zone of India. This record does not determine that an offence has occurred.
requirements: A foreign vessel used for fishing within any maritime zone of India must operate under and in accordance with a licence granted under section 4 or a permit granted under section 5 by the Central Government, subject to the provisions of the Act.
A licence or permit not being produced is a fact requiring verification; it is not by itself a finding that no valid licence or permit exists.
The legal question is whether the vessel holds and is operating under a valid applicable licence or permit and is complying with applicable requirements.
requiredDocuments: Licence status: DOCUMENT PRODUCED, DOCUMENT NOT PRODUCED, or DOCUMENT STATUS UNKNOWN
Licence or permit verification status: DOCUMENT VERIFIED or DOCUMENT VALIDITY NOT VERIFIED
conditions: The vessel is used for fishing.
The fishing is within a maritime zone of India; the applicable maritime zone requires separate confirmation.
The relevant licence or permit must be identified and its validity and applicability verified.
exceptions: Fishing under and in accordance with a licence granted under section 4.
Fishing under and in accordance with a permit granted under section 5.
Subject to the provisions of the Act.
notes: This record represents a legal requirement only. It does not establish an offence, infer that a licence is invalid, or convert the fact 'licence not produced' into 'no valid licence'.
